newsitem.title: USA: CBOE, AMEX to list Cymer options, CBOE Nokia LEAPS.
newsitem.headline: CBOE, AMEX to list Cymer options, CBOE Nokia LEAPS.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange and the American Stock Exchange said Tuesday they would begin trading options on shares of Cymer Inc on March 25.
The CBOE also said it would trade LEAPS (long term equity anticipation securities) on the American Depositary Shares (ADSs) of Nokia Corp from March 19.
On both exchanges, Cymer options would open with strike prices of 30, 35 and 40, with initial expirations in April, May, August and November.
The AMEX has set 7,500-contract position limits.
At the CBOE, Cymer options will trade in the General Electric Co trading crowd.
Group One Trading LP has been named the specialist for Cymer options at the AMEX.
For the Nokia ADS LEAPS, opening strike prices have been set at 50, 60, 70 and 80, with expirations in January 1998 and January 1999, the CBOE said.
